svg.title: Level 1 - Application processes and data stores
svg.text: Level 1 - Application processes and data stores
MySQL is authoritative. Neo4j and FAISS are derived projections; the embedding cache contains public patent vectors only.
Process 3.0 groups retrieval, evaluation, improvements and public graph/report reads.
Evaluation and improvement are separate requests, not mandatory pipeline steps.
Process 2.0 persists their output and restores existing runs without recomputing.
Session and case ownership are checked on every protected request.
Yourdon-DeMarco: circle = process | rectangle = external entity | parallel lines = data store | arrow = data flow
Arrows name the data being transferred. Repeated IDs refer to the same entity/store. Line jumps are unconnected crossings.
